algorithm: Fixed timetable; best-fit room batching; student-level accommodations; course-window equipment reservations; soft specialist-room protection

room_selection_policy.specialist_equipment_threshold: equipment available in 40% or fewer of active rooms
room_selection_policy.policy: Prefer rooms without scarce equipment unless the exam requires it. Prefer LAB and ACCESSIBLE room types for matching requirements. Specialist rooms remain eligible when needed.

equipment_reservation_policy.window: first course sitting start through final sitting effective end
equipment_reservation_policy.quantity: peak required quantity across the course's three sittings
equipment_reservation_policy.room_policy: Different rooms allowed between sittings; each assigned room must contain required equipment locally.

notes: Course equipment reservation is a shared-inventory hold, not a physical transfer of equipment between rooms.
Room-local equipment is independently checked for every assigned room.
Separate-room students are assigned one per room.
Invigilator assignment is a later phase.
Any exception means the affected student(s) or sitting is not fully assigned.
